experiment_6_uncertainty_propagation.abstention_handling: Water sports (surfing, swimming, snorkeling) and eco-tours (waterfalls, wildlife) strictly flag CLIMATE_ONLY_PARTIAL with missing marine/safety evidence alerts, preventing false safety assertions.

experiment_7_regional_case_studies.Central_Highlands_Nuwara_Eliya: Hiking most favorable Jan-March; October-November experience peak monsoon cloudiness and rainfall.
